# Vendored

Unmodified builds from npm. The panel loads them from the tweak server, so nothing comes from a CDN.

| File | Package | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tweakpane.min.js` | [tweakpane](https://github.com/cocopon/tweakpane) | 4.0.5 | MIT |
| `tweakpane-plugin-essentials.min.js` | [@tweakpane/plugin-essentials](https://github.com/tweakpane/plugin-essentials) | 0.2.1 | MIT |

To update, run `npm pack <package>@<version>`, then copy `package/dist/*.min.js` here.
